callGraph.callee:
clauses
      .map((clause) =>
        isDefaultClause(clause)
          ? `* as ${clause.alias}`
          : (clause as NamedImport).import
          ? `{ ${(clause as NamedImport).import} ${
            clause.as ? "as " + clause.as : ""
          }}`
          : clause.as
      )
      .join
